name: The Bachelor (American TV series) season 1
profileSummary: The Bachelor was the first season of ABC reality television series The Bachelor. The show featured 31-year-old Alex Michel, a Harvard educated management consultant from Charlottesville, Virginia. The season premiered on March 25, 2002, and concluded on April 25, 2002, with Michel choosing to pursue a relationship with 23-year-old event planner Amanda Marsh. They broke up several months later.
